distinctions_ru.checkpoint_candidate_vs_promoted_checkpo: Candidate means a discovered/readable checkpoint artifact with hash/readback/fresh-load guard context. Promoted checkpoint requires selected target, quality/compatibility/load gate, promotion owner, rollback binding, locator binding and host reload evidence. Existing evidence proves only the narrow candidate/readback/guard side.
distinctions_ru.locator_readback_guard_vs_actual_locator: Locator readback/guard may show locator map presence or direct-promotion rejection. Actual locator update requires locator source of truth, before/after diff, write/update evidence, fresh-load from updated locator, rollback locator and per-host reload evidence.
distinctions_ru.rollback_binding_and_target_promotion: Promotion remains blocked until rollback checkpoint/locator target is selected before write, backup/readback is captured, rollback operation is verified, and target promotion is tied to common/user-adaptive ownership and host reload evidence.

conclusion.supported_claim: Existing evidence supports only narrow checkpoint candidate discovery/readback/fresh-load guard and direct-promotion rejection.
